ms.criteria: A Github Repository link that holds the scaffolding for the open source voting tool. Initial code will be deployed at this step, and the developers will continue to audit the code during future milestones.
ms.report:
Work continues on releasing the Open Source version of the voting tool. As promised, the separate GitHub repository has been created. It is currently fully populated with schemas and documentation regarding the voting tool. Work has been completed to move the code base out of the DripDropz code, and on to it's own separate code base. A proof of work is attached here: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/11bB1EYZNQJqYis5jKDCkdRUOX2c-0Q5B_VFCXUhOkTs/edit?usp=sharing which shows commits from LatheesanK accomplishing this part of the task. As we move towards our February report, we will begin to release more of the code into public viewing, and we will commit the Gitbook pages for the user manual. We are on track to deliver this project on time. The Github Repository is located at: https://github.com/DripDropz/onchain-voting
In addition we did give a community update at Townhall, which concluded the published results of the Catalyst Circle v4 election. We provided both lessons learned, and final, verified results to the participants at Town Hall, as well as provided a list of resources for interested users to be able to further understand the vote. The TownHall presentation is available here: https://youtu.be/8Y_61HPR7EM?t=2469

ms.promise: A Gitbook link. Continued code development on Github.
